gloss: familiarity with an area, local knowledge

definitions.gloss: familiarity with an area, sense of local geography
definitions.explanation: Knowledge of the layout, streets, and landmarks of a particular area, typically gained through experience of living in or frequently visiting that area.

examples.japanese: {土地勘|とちかん}がないので{迷|まよ}った。
examples.english: I got lost because I'm unfamiliar with the area.

examples.japanese: {土地勘|とちかん}のある{人|ひと}に{案内|あんない}してもらった。
examples.english: I had someone who knows the area guide me.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}してきたばかりで、まだ{土地勘|とちかん}がない。
examples.english: I just moved here, so I don't know the area yet.

notes:
{土地勘|とちかん} refers to familiarity with the geography and layout of a particular area.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {土地勘|とちかん}がある (to know an area well)
- {土地勘|とちかん}がない (to be unfamiliar with an area)
- {土地勘|とちかん}のある{人|ひと} (someone who knows the area)

KANJI NOTE:
- Sometimes written as {土地鑑|とちかん} with the kanji {鑑|かん} (discern), but {勘|かん} (intuition) is more common
